headline: Duke Energy Progress reaches agreement with North Carolina Public Staff and other stakeholders to deliver a lower-cost path to power North Carolina's future
summary: After listening carefully to customer and stakeholder feedback, Duke Energy Progress and stakeholders have reached an agreement that will allow the company to continue building the infrastructure needed to reliably serve North Carolina while reducing the proposed rate increase by more than half.

headline: What Duke Energy Florida customers need to know as summer heat peaks in August
summary: Recent summers have been 10% to 15% hotter than the long-term average, and August is historically when temperatures peak in Florida. As humidity also rises across the state, AC systems are working harder and using more energy to keep up. In fact, roughly 30% of a single unit's output can go toward removing moisture.
